design_rationale: Inspired by Candour.app QR micro-experiences and modern Indian fine casual hospitality (Mana Restaurant, Shankarpally). Built as an offline-first PWA review assistant for mobile portrait view (max 480px centered on desktop) with zero-login friction. Warm cream/amber palette, rich saffron/terracotta kinetic triggers, pill-shaped tags, and empathetic multi-step transition flows.

entry_surfaces./: Mobile portrait container max-480px with warm restaurant header (Mana Restaurant, Shankarpally), live offline indicator, table/POS order card, and interactive 5-star rating entry screen

layout_and_container.alignment: mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FDFBF7] shadow-2xl border-x border-[#EFEAE1] relative flex flex-col
layout_and_container.desktop_backdrop: bg-[#1E1B18] flex items-center justify-center p-0 sm:py-6 sm:px-4

step_flow_architecture.step_0_header: Restaurant signature header with warm amber motif, location tag 'Shankarpally, Hyderabad', POS Table #12 badge, and active offline status bar.

step_1_star_gate.prompt: How was your dining experience today?
step_1_star_gate.component: Interactive star selector (1 to 5 stars) with warm pulse micro-interactions and tactile score descriptions ('Poor', 'Fair', 'Average', 'Very Good', 'Exceptional!')
step_1_star_gate.branching: 1-3 stars triggers CRM Resolution flow; 4-5 stars advances immediately to Step 2 AI review generation

crm_feedback_branch.title: What went wrong with your food or service?
crm_feedback_branch.subtitle: Your feedback reaches our General Manager directly to make things right.
crm_feedback_branch.resolution_state: Thank you. Our restaurant manager has been notified directly via SMS & CRM alert. We appreciate your honesty and will address this immediately.

step_2_tag_selection.optional_note: Any specific dish name or note? (Optional)

step_3_ai_draft_cards.description: 3 Distinct review voices tailored for Indian restaurant Google profiles

styles.label: Short & Direct
styles.desc: Crisp, impactful, highlights key dishes & service

styles.label: Descriptive & Detailed
styles.desc: Elaborates on authentic spices, ambiance & portion sizes

styles.label: Warm & Casual Hinglish
styles.desc: Natural conversational Hinglish with genuine appreciation

step_3_ai_draft_cards.interaction: Tapping a card selects it with an active amber glow border and auto-populates the rich editable textarea below.

step_4_action_cta.toast_message: Review copied to clipboard! Paste it on Google Review box.

offline_capabilities.engine: Local algorithmic template synthesizer + cached LLM permutations in localStorage
offline_capabilities.banner: You are offline. Your review draft will still work locally.
offline_capabilities.crm_fallback: Offline complaints are stored in indexedDB / localStorage queue and synced once connection restores.

motion.screen_transitions: AnimatePresence with slide-up & fade (y: 12, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.25s)
motion.ai_generating_pulse: warm amber shimmer bar with staggered pill highlights

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height on all interactive tags and CTA buttons
accessibility.contrast_check: All text tokens meet 4.5:1 on their respective surface tokens
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion using conditional CSS transitions
accessibility.data_testids: Every button, star, pill, textarea, card, and toast trigger MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes

image_urls.description: Authentic Hyderabadi Dum Biryani hero banner for Mana Restaurant

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + Vite/React 19 frontend). CSS entry is frontend/src/index.css.
In frontend/src/index.css, import '@fontsource-variable/lora' for headings and '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans' for body.
Implement the app inside frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx with clean modular components or subcomponents in frontend/src/components/review/.
Ensure zero login: no signup wall, instant QR table experience. Support simulated POS order switch (e.g. Table 12: Special Chicken Biryani, Paneer Tikka, Butter Naan).
Support offline-first mode: test with window.navigator.onLine toggle or mock offline switch in header to preview offline banner and client-side generative draft fallback.
Provide rich AI review draft generation with realistic authentic prompt synthesizer (incorporating selected POS dishes, food tags, service tags, and user custom note).
Make sure Step 1 (1-3 stars -> CRM form with manager alert toast/thank you) and (4-5 stars -> Step 2 Tags -> Step 3 Drafts -> Step 4 Copy & Google) are seamless with smooth motion transitions.
Include sonner toast notifications with 'Review copied! Paste it on Google.' and direct window.open trigger.
Add full data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for test compliance.
